using namespace std;

int main() {
    vector<string> tokens;
    string line;
    while (getline(cin, line)) {
        istringstream iss(line);
        string token;
        while (iss >> token) {
            tokens.push_back(token);
        }
    }

    int n = stoi(tokens[0]);
    vector<long long> a(3), b(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) a[i] = stoll(tokens[1 + i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) b[i] = stoll(tokens[4 + i]);

    long long max_val = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0]);
    long long min_val = max(0LL, a[0] + b[1] - n)
                      + max(0LL, a[1] + b[2] - n)
                      + max(0LL, a[2] + b[0] - n);

    cout << min_val << " " << max_val << endl;
    return 0;
}
